courtyard_lamps.limits: Single visible fixture only. Station and offset are proportional estimates relative to the existing path; no repeated spacing or additional fixtures are implied.

bridge_west_lamps.limits: Only the nearest pair. Relative placement uses the existing approximate west stair toe; longitudinal position remains uncertain within -1.5 to +0.3 m. No repeated row or garden boundary is implied.

bridge_west_noticeboards.limits: Two nearest pairs of side-by-side panels only. Longitudinal offset is approximate within 0 to 1.5 m from the existing west toe. Poster content and unverified rear displays are not reproduced.
